text: Hint 1: Recall that in an OLS model, the residuals (the difference between the true outcomes and the predicted outcomes) are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix. This is a fundamental property of the least squares solution.\n\nHint 2: Consider the geometric interpretation of the OLS solution. The predicted values $\hat{Y}$ are the orthogonal projection of $Y$ onto the column space of $\mathbb{X}$. What does this imply about the relationship between $Y - \hat{Y}$ and $\hat{Y}$?
